title: RideLink Extended-Stay Lodging Rate Schedule
content:
For long stays away from home on a Non-Emergency Medical Transportation long-distance trip, lodging is paid on a descending scale of nightly rates.

**Rule.** The lodging nights are paid on a taper set by how many nights lie between the outbound leg's appointment date and the return leg's appointment date:

- when those are at least 28 nights (the monthly-stay nights), the first 7 nights of the stay (the weekly-stay nights) are paid the level's standard nightly lodging allowance, the following nights up to the 28th night the weekly-stay nightly rate of 72.00 USD, and every later night the monthly-stay nightly rate of 58.00 USD;
- when they are at least 7 but fewer than 28, the first 7 nights are paid the standard nightly allowance and every later night the weekly-stay nightly rate of 72.00 USD;
- when they are fewer than 7, no taper applies and every lodging night is paid the standard nightly allowance.

The band is chosen by the nights between the two appointment dates; within the band, every lodging night the stay counts is paid.

## Schedule

| Nights between the appointment dates | Nights 1 to 7 | Nights 8 to 28 | Nights 29 onward |
|---|---|---|---|
| Fewer than 7 | Level's standard nightly allowance | Level's standard nightly allowance | — |
| 7 to 27 | Level's standard nightly allowance | 72.00 USD | 72.00 USD |
| 28 or more | Level's standard nightly allowance | 72.00 USD | 58.00 USD |

## Worked figures

*Hypothetical inputs, on a level whose standard nightly lodging allowance is 85.00 USD:*

| Nights between the dates | Lodging nights counted | Lodging pay |
|---|---|---|
| 5 | 5 | 5 nights at 85.00: 425.00 USD |
| 6 | 7 | Fewer than 7 between the dates, so 7 nights at 85.00: 595.00 USD |
| 10 | 11 | 7 at 85.00 (595.00) and 4 at 72.00 (288.00): 883.00 USD |
| 28 | 28 | 7 at 85.00 (595.00) and 21 at 72.00 (1,512.00): 2,107.00 USD |
| 30 | 30 | 595.00, 1,512.00 and 2 at 58.00 (116.00): 2,223.00 USD |
